levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: «حدثنا أبي ح» : the bare «أبي» is a relation link; the two branches meet at the tail (rule 3)
«قال سئلت عن المتلاعنين» : the asker is not named, so no link is added; Ibn Umar, whose house Sa'id visits and who answers, is the last link (rule 6)
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss, left out
